name: LDAP / Active Directory
description: Sign in with LDAP or Active Directory accounts (username/password, also for the API). Groups are synchronized at every sign-in and, with the directory sync, also without one; they are mapped to local groups and roles.
author: Enterprise Wiki

limits.label: People per directory sync
limits.help: Most entries one directory sync reads. A directory with more entries stops the run instead of syncing only a part.
